BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_RUMMAGE.title: Rummage
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_RUMMAGE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Draw 1 card and reduce its cost by 1 this turn.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CARDISTRY.title: Cardistry
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CARDISTRY.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. The next card you play returns to your draw pile.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_VINDICATE.title: Vindicate
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_POISON_STAB.title: Poison Stab
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CLAW_STRIKE.title: Claw Strike
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PACK_RIP.title: Pack Rip
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PACK_RIP.descriptio: Rip open a random card pack, adding one of its cards to your hand.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PM_CLAW.title: Claw
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PM_CLAW.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Increase the damage of all Claw cards by 2.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_GHOST_CLAW.title: Ghost Claw
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_GHOST_CLAW.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Increase the damage of all Claw cards by 2. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CLOAK_AND_CLAW.desc: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add 1 Ghost Claw to your hand.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_TWIN_CLAW.title: Twin Claw
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_TWIN_CLAW.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice. Increase the damage of all Claw cards by 2.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_SEARING_CLAW.title: Searing Claw
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_SEARING_CLAW.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Increase the damage of all Claw cards by 2.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CLAW_FOR_ONE.title: Claw For One
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CLAW_FOR_ONE.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Return all Claw cards from your discard pile to your hand.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CONCLAWD.title: Conclawd
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_CONCLAWD.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Increase the damage of all Claw cards by 2.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_INFINITE_CLAWS.desc: Gain a power: at the start of each turn, add a Ghost Claw to your hand.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_TALK_TO_THE_CLAW.de: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Whenever this enemy is attacked by a Claw card, gain 2 Block. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_MUTATE_CLAW.title: Mutate Claw
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_MUTATE_CLAW.descrip: Choose an Attack card in your hand. Grant it the Claw tag.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_DARK_LANCE.title: Dark Lance
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_DECAPITATE.title: Decapitate
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_DECAPITATE.descript: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. The enemy loses {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_EPIPHANY.title: Epiphany
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_LUNATIC_RAGE.title: Lunatic Rage
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_LUNATIC_RAGE.descri: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Gain 2 Energy. Discard all non-Attack cards in your hand. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_SLAM.title: Slam
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_SLAM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain that much Block.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_ANIMOSITY.title: Animosity
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_BACKSTRIKE.title: Backstrike
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PENALTY_STRIKE.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice. The enemy loses {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_STRIKE_ABARGAIN.des: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. All Attack cards in your hand cost 0 this turn. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_STRIKE_OF_LUCK.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy 1-3 times.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_WORKERS_STRIKE.desc: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. ALL enemies lose {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_ENRAGE.title: Enrage
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_EXCITEMENT.title: Excitement
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_GREATER_HEX.title: Greater Hex
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_GREATER_HEX.descrip: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak, {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable, and {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength loss to the enemy. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_LAYERED_DEFENSES.de: Gain {Block:diff()} Block for each card type in your hand.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_LESSER_HEX.title: Lesser Hex
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_LESSER_HEX.descript: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak, {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable, and {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength loss. Add a Greater Hex to your discard pile. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_PREEMPTIVE_STRIKE.d: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the enemy intends to attack, deal it again.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_RARE_STRIKE.title: Rare Strike
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_RARE_STRIKE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deals 2 more damage for each Rare card you have.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_REPLENISH.title: Replenish
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_REPLENISH.descripti: Put {Cards:diff()} random cards from your discard pile into your hand. Exhaust.
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_WHISPERS.title: Whispers
BLOOMLESS_SPIRE_CARD_WHISPERS.descriptio: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Add a Dazed to your hand.
